tools.name: check_solana_transaction
tools.description: Use before signing an unsigned Solana transaction, not for a token mint alone. Provide the base64 transaction and optional signer and expected intent. Simulation returns ALLOW, WARN or BLOCK with reasons and balance changes. Costs $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: check_solana_token_risk
tools.description: Use before buying a pump.fun token when you have its Solana mint address. Returns specific rug risk flags with measured precision; no flags does not mean safe. Costs $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description: Get the result of an accepted queued check for free.

tools.name: retry_failed_job
tools.description: Retry a failed paid job for free.
